session_revocation.exact_original_cookie_proof: The helper retains the single crm_session Cookie header in memory before logout. For each actor, UI logout returned 204 and navigated to /login. Cleanup then sent DELETE /api/session with that exact original Cookie and got 204, followed by GET /api/me with the same original Cookie and got 401. These are explicit HTTP replays, not requests depending on a cleared browser cookie jar. No cookie value is stored in this inspection.

helper_references.meaning: Explicit Cookie header supplied to bounded cleanup HTTP requests
Original crm_session Cookie retained in memory
DELETE then GET replay the retained original Cookie

session_revocation.proof_scope: This proves both sessions were invalid at the end after the explicit cleanup DELETE. It does not separately isolate revocation by the preceding UI DELETE before cleanup replay.
